notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source that names this site is the FFLA Wyoming list, under Unknown/Undocumented Sites, with coordinates matching the record. Two searches returned only unrelated Gros Ventre news (the Kinky Creek Fire and the Gros Ventre fire-station project), and the cache has no register entry, guide or news item describing a lookout here. The 1941, 1942 and 1954 Courier notices are regional context: they do not name this site. The editor may cut the middle paragraph if it reads as padding. A human could check Teton National Forest lookout records for 1941 to 1954 before deciding whether this site was ever staffed. Access and remains are unknown.
